column1: # The kinds of `consensus_protocol` a group record may declare, typed: who is counted and the rule the count must meet.

# rule: role_at:{role}:{n} | all | strict_majority | voices:{m} | weight:{rubric} | predicate:{id} | joiner. removal_rule adds all_and_majority.
# `unstated` where the text gives no rule for a removal under the kind.

column7: Founders are the sole admission authority
every member other than the target signs *and* those signers are a strict majority of the roster
> 50% of the members at the roster head the row names must sign.
Any `m` members must sign, `m` an absolute count
The sum of the signing members' weights must reach a threshold.
